label: Infant formula
note: Skim milk has too much protein and mineral for a baby, so lactose and demineralised whey are added to bring the casein : whey ratio from milk's roughly 80 : 20 towards human milk's 40 : 60 (the ratio is not controlled in Europe).

about.text: A manufactured food that replaces breast milk for babies under 12 months. Cow-milk formula starts from skim milk, which is re-balanced with demineralised whey, lactose and vegetable oils, then vitamins and minerals, and is mostly sold as a spray-dried powder.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Milk about 80 : 20; formulas moved towards human milk, most often cited 40 : 60
Powders mixed with no heat step, so the microbial quality rests on the raw materials; oil cannot be mixed in unless encapsulated
